text: City Council, through item SC18.12, directed the Transit Expansion Division to report to Scarborough Community Council (SCC) with regular status updates on Metrolinx’s Scarborough Subway Extension (SSE) project. City staff will provide the next semi-annual report to SCC in Q2 2027. The purpose of this report is to provide updates on the status of construction activities on the SSE project, including on: - Construction Progress; - Community Benefits and Supports; and - Public Engagement.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Received the report (May 11, 2026) from the Executive Director, Transit Expansion for information.
